results.title: A$AP Rocky Songline
results.overview: A$AP Rocky brings hits from his latest album Don't Be Dumb alongside memorable classics and an in depth look at his creative process for an exclusive Amazon Music Songline.

results.title: The Big League
results.overview: Eliran Ben-Tovim, a star soccer coach on the verge of national glory, loses everything after a violent outburst during a crucial match. Banned from professional football, he reluctantly accepts coaching a failing middle-school team in a remote northern village. There, among misfit kids and unexpected love, Eliran rediscovers his passion for the game and for life, ultimately choosing purpose and community over fame.

results.title: Lice
results.overview: After waking up with no memory of how she got home, a spiraling woman desperately tries to reconstruct a lost night, fearing she has single-handedly ruined her entire life in a single evening.

results.title: First They Came for My College
results.original_title: First They Came for My College
results.overview: When the Governor of Florida transforms a beloved public honors college in a political coup, students and professors confront a new reality: their campus is ground zero in a growing nation-wide assault on academic freedom.

results.title: Warish
results.overview: Eid UL Adha Natok of Bangladesh

results.title: Human Resource
results.overview: A financial horror comedy about Shae, a millennial HR manager who’s given everything to her beloved tech company — and been given purpose, friends, and bountiful perks in return. But when the market crashes and the company is acquired in a hostile takeover, Shae’s value as an employee is thrown into question. Desperate to save herself and her colleagues from the new private equity owner's restructuring strategy, Shae makes a dangerous deal to secure their jobs — only to discover a fate worse than termination

results.title: The Water Is Always Warm
results.overview: Follows the dissolution of a friendship as one friend becomes involved in a controversial religion. The haunted comedy unfolds through a series of dinners over the course of several years, each date farther apart than the last.

results.title: Content
results.overview: Nia turns missing women into headlines and killers into targets. But when a dangerous listener follows her on a remote getaway, she becomes the story.

results.title: Enough
results.overview: Sonia can’t stop scrolling through photos of her ex-girlfriend. But when a sleepless night bends reality, she’s forced to face what she’s really holding onto.

results.title: Màquina
results.overview: When a father consumed by alcoholism agrees to join his son on a journey through psychedelic-assisted addiction treatment in Colorado, their road trip across the American West in an aging Winnebago becomes an unflinching exploration of codependency, memory, and hope.

results.title: Nick Guerra: Risk Taker
results.overview: Nick Guerra turns everyday chaos into big laughs. Find out about the beauty of the skip intro guy, the soundtrack to future drug commercials, and why your brain and body can't see eye-to-eye. Risky comedy in front of a group of strangers.

results.title: La Chandleur
results.overview: Albert, a young man in his twenties, lives alone in his grandfather's country house under one condition: he must take care of the farm animals. While getting ready for a date, he discovers that a fox has attacked the ducks in the coop. Determined to protect the last surviving goose, Albert cancels his dinner and spends the night waiting for the animal. But he realizes that what he is hunting is not just a simple fox, but a far more terrifying entity: the Chandleur.

results.title: Family Dinner
results.overview: In a near-future food-starved America, Mia returns home for a sumptuous family dinner in the wake of her grandma's death.

results.title: El último mono
results.overview: A man organizes courses aimed at men, specifically so-called "alpha males." As part of a challenge, he must win the heart of a feminist woman with whom, initially, he stands no chance.

results.title: Jeffrey Dollmer
results.overview: Dahmer finds a doll in 1991 and performs a ritual in an attempt to transfer his spirit into it but is captured before he can finish his evil plans. For decades, the doll remains locked away in police evidence — until it is finally discarded and finds its way back into the world. In the present day, the doll’s spirit is accidentally summoned and quickly latches onto a young model who bears a resemblance to its former owner. When the model travels to a remote photo shoot, the possessed doll follows, turning the isolated set into a killing ground as it begins stalking fellow competitors and co-workers.

results.title: Silent Voices: Seyid Huseyn
results.overview: Dedicated to the life and work of Seyid Huseyn Sadigzadeh.

results.title: That Damn Cat
results.overview: A cat becomes envious of his owner's romantic interests.

results.title: Cocaine: A Colombian Powderkeg
results.overview: Cocaine is more widespread than ever before with more regular users and seizures at an all time high. In Colombia, production is booming, and after years of relative calm, extreme violence has come back to the streets with the drug traffickers. This documentary reveals the reality of today’s cocaine trade from production to export.
